drills.title: Find the bug: duplicate handling
drills.prompt: A HashMap solution overwrites an index before checking its complement. Identify the failing input and explain why.

drills.title: Write the breaking test
drills.prompt: Create the smallest test that distinguishes a nested-loop solution from an O(n) solution.

drills.title: Is this diff safe to merge?
drills.prompt: Review a change that removes null validation from a public method. List the risk, test, and safer alternative.

drills.title: Read the stack trace
drills.prompt: Trace a NullPointerException to its first invalid assumption, then propose a regression test.

drills.title: Design an order status API
drills.prompt: Choose API boundaries, persistence, idempotency, retries, and observability.

concepts.title: Big-O
concepts.text: Big-O describes how work grows with input size. A single pass is O(n); nested passes are often O(n²).

concepts.title: Arrays and strings
concepts.text: Arrays give O(1) indexed access. Strings are immutable; use StringBuilder for repeated concatenation.

concepts.title: Hash maps
concepts.text: HashMap stores key/value pairs with average O(1) lookup. Always ask what the key should represent.

concepts.title: Stacks and queues
concepts.text: ArrayDeque supports push/pop at the ends. Use a queue for BFS and a stack for DFS.

concepts.title: Recursion
concepts.text: Define a base case, make progress toward it, and combine the returned result.
